Status SourceOnlyUnverified. Private consumer patch, not applied. Expected base WN immutable
sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012@0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035 supplied by Main;
original/modified bytes hashed separately. No Git HEAD query performed. No old worktree/packet/report
modified. No source import/AST/test/compiler/build/lint/model/GPU/profiler/process/Git/cleanup run.

Exactly3modified source copies: expert_source.hpp adds request observer shared ownership/API;
expert_source.cpp owns bounded aggregate and hooks actual native grouped-pool dispatch only;
generate.cpp creates prompt-scope observer, binds serial read_windows, notes excluded batched parts,
finishes after prompt/refill and before REUSED/decode; RAII reports partial early error/return once.
No CMake/observer ledger/pool calibration/kernel implementation/issuer math modifications.

Opt-in exact STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_JOB_HISTOGRAM=1, frozen flag; defaultOFF. No product CLI addition,
no --stats interpretation change, no per-job log. Native actual run_split_multi_native dispatch hook
records layer and actual independent gu_type/d_type from NativeFmt, countjobs, sum job.nt rows,
NT1..8 bucket job counts. Records actual assembled CPU miss jobs after routing/cache/remote decisions,
BEFORE unchanged production pool call; therefore counts dispatch attempts, not proof completed math.
CPU calibration calls are separate callsites and not hooked. Decode/calibration have no binding.
GPU resident/offloaded rows never become CPU jobs; no theoretical miss/hit/byte inference added.

Eligibility: serve serial prompt read_windows only, o.batch<=0, n_stages==1, no pipeline, no MTP,
existing pool present, native layout complete for1..64layers. Unsupported config/allocation failure
prints eligible0 when requested, leaves model dispatch unchanged. Fixed64layer envelope is diagnostic,
not a model/runtime admission restriction; actual model geometry comes from layout. Numeric GGML
GU/Down format IDs identify real layer formats, not guessed pack name. No nonnative job histogram.
No standalone/non-serve generate histogram added; no batch/parallel/multigpu/pipeline claims.

A binding spans only each serial read_windows call. Mutex-protected state persists across all such
parts in ONE prompt request, covering checkpoint-split/reused-prefix fresh spans; output records prompt
n and read_from. read_part marks batched calls, never attaches observer: purebatched8192 prints
coverage=no_serial_windows cpu_histogram_work=0 and has no NT8192 fabrication. Mixed route reports
serial-only counters plus batched_parts (part calls, not chunk/window counts); never full-prompt CPU
coverage inferred. serial_parts counts read_windows invocations, not verifier windows.

Request lifetime/concurrency:
- No global cumulative counters or reset/delta subtraction. Each requested eligible prompt constructs
  one small heap state with64fixed rows, exact layer type pairs; driver scope holds strong ownership.
- ExpertDispatch member is shared_ptr accessed with std atomic_load/CAS free functions at runtime.
  Binding attaches only if empty; overlap flags invalid without overwriting other owner or changing math.
  Dispatch loads its own strong reference before reading counts; no borrowed stack observer pointer.
- CPU callback records under host mutex (at most128jobs, NT1..8); GPU/device never reads observer state.
  Job array read is synchronous before pool launch, same callback thread that built those job.nt fields;
  no worker output/counters/activation/router writes added. Original pool/order/dispatch call preserved.
- Binding detaches on normal/error/exception lambda exit. finish defensively detaches its own state,
  then deactivates/snapshots under same mutex as record writers. Retained references make late record
  safe; inactive state refuses updates. No GPU allocation/free/wait, host_task, volatile polling,
  device atomics or completion changes. State does not own job/activation/session/GPU buffers.
- Existing engine's serial run/commit/wait_commit/refill and fatal handoff/teardown remain authoritative
  for request ordering and ExpertDispatch lifetime. This observer cannot heal an unconfirmed old window
  overlapping a new request. Main must review those preexisting boundaries; any invalid/partial observer
  data is ineligible. Drive copy at generate.cpp7597 happens before request scopes, while pointerempty;
  batch/parallel scopes never attach. Copying Drive while an observer is active is unsupported.
- finish is idempotent, explicit normal/cancelled prompt boundary precedes decode; destructor labels
  error_or_early_exit for partial/fatal returns. Queries before scope creation have no histogram work.

Finite output/arithmetic:
- uint64 jobs/rows/NT/part counters saturate on overflow and flag overflow; never wrap or change math.
  Bad layer/type/NT/overlap flags invalid. Main rejects invalid/overflow/partial as complete histogram.
- Fixed64layers x8NT. One header+at most64layerlines/request, or2lines purebatched, or1unsupported.
  Status text limited32bytes, integerfields bounded widths; output comfortably<32KiB/request. Evenzero
  CPUjobs layers print actual type pair/zero rows when serial route ran; no job per-call/per-token logs.
- Existing default math/dispatch/routing/outputIDs untouched by intent; disabled feature has no heap
  state/output/atomic histogram load. It still adds a frozen-flag branch/small stack scope overhead.
  Enabled feature adds integer counting/mutex/shared ownership and stderr overhead; no speed claim.
- Counts are expert-token rows, not GEMM token span8192, DRAM/PCIe bytes, FLOPs, timing or completed
  kernel proof. Correlate with existing pool/activation/dispatch timings only after actual qualification;
  R248/R237 roofline/byte boundaries remain. No old pool benchmark or issuer ledger reimplemented.

Main test plan in MAIN_TEST_PLAN.txt; no test source registration/execution included. This private
patch needs Main review/full rebuild/CPU sanitizer/lints/request routing + output parity + fault/
normalclosure qualification before any measurement. Existing active pristine official source untouched.
